policy.KEEP: Preserve the historical mechanism and interaction role; rebuild it natively.
policy.MERGE: Fold this lighter web interaction into a larger native beat or interaction while retaining its causal contribution.
policy.REWRITE: Retain the historical subject but replace the web behaviour with a deeper native causal action.
policy.REMOVE: Discard when no causal contribution survives. No current item is assigned REMOVE in this draft.
policy.portingRule: No TypeScript component or web gesture is a native runtime specification.
